scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:api
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:env && npm run verify:compose && python -m compileall services/integration-service/app services/integration-service/migrations services/gis-service/app services/gis-service/migrations
scripts.release:verify: npm run verify:env && npm run verify:foundation && npm run ops:verify && npm run build
scripts.demo:seed: docker exec -i sigi-platform-postgres-1 psql -U sigi_user -d sigi_db -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/003_phase5_demo_seed.sql
scripts.demo:migrate:odoo: docker exec -i sigi-platform-postgres-1 psql -U sigi_user -d sigi_db -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/006_odoo_source_admin.sql
scripts.demo:empty:up: npm run build:api && docker compose --project-name sigi-empty-demo --env-file infra/empty-demo.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.empty-demo.yml up -d --build
scripts.demo:empty:down: docker compose --project-name sigi-empty-demo --env-file infra/empty-demo.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.empty-demo.yml down
scripts.demo:empty:destroy: docker compose --project-name sigi-empty-demo --env-file infra/empty-demo.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.empty-demo.yml down --volumes
scripts.demo:empty:logs: docker compose --project-name sigi-empty-demo --env-file infra/empty-demo.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.empty-demo.yml logs --follow
scripts.release:gate:ci: npm run ci:prepare:prod-env && npm run verify:env:prod && npm run release:gate
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:api && node --test tests/unit/**/*.test.mjs && npm run test:python
